footer.about: We're a local, family owned roofing company in Wichita. We replace and repair roofs, and we do siding, gutters, paint, windows and deck staining.
why: Crew cleans up, and we come back after

Your customers make your case. You hold a 5.0 on 9 Google reviews, and they say it: "Anthony crawled into the attic and onto the roof and found that our CHIMNEY CHASE was leaking." "Anthony showed up shortly after they left to make sure I was pleased with the roof."
Your website hides all of it. Its tap-to-call buttons dial 123-456-7890, and no page has a headline that says you're a roofing company in Wichita.
So we built this site around their words.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Roofing Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page: what your site does today, and what we changed.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The page Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: The tap-to-call buttons at the bottom of every page dial 123-456-7890, and the number at the top is plain text, so nobody on a phone can call you in one tap.
No page shows a headline. The one Google reads says "Home", so it can't tell you're a roofing company in Wichita.
None of your Google reviews appear anywhere on the site.
fixes: Your number is one tap to call, on every page.
A headline that says roofing company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Real reviews from your customers, each beside the point it proves.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

cards.title: Roof Replacement
cards.why: A new roof is a big decision, and it has no page of its own.
problems: One "Roofing" page covers every kind of roof job, so nobody searching for roof replacement in Wichita lands on a page about it.
Nothing on the page says what a customer gets: the estimate, the cleanup, the follow-up.
fixes: A full page for roof replacement in Wichita, KS: materials, the detailed estimate and the steps of the job.
A review from a customer whose crew picked up after the job and who got a visit afterward.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Roof Repair
cards.why: Your customers praise how you handled leaks and wind damage, and repair has no page either.
problems: Roof repair sits as one line on the "Roofing" page, so Google has nothing to rank for a leak or storm damage search.
fixes: A full page for roof repair in Wichita, KS, with the chimney chase leak and the wind damage told in your customers' words.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where a ready customer reaches you.
problems: The site shows no email address, so there's nothing to write to.
The number at the bottom dials a placeholder, and the number on the roofing page is plain text.
fixes: Your real number one tap away, with your hours and your address.
A short list of what to have ready.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

onboardingQuestions:
Who is Anthony (owner, partner, manager), and what is his surname? Can the site name him and say how he is introduced?
Who is the owner? BuildZoom lists Wilbur Engel; the site names no one. May we use the name?
Legal name: River City Roofing, LLC (site footer) or Honey Do Homes, LLC dba River City Roofing (logo and BuildZoom)?
Since when? The site says 2011; listings say 13 years, 14 years and 2003. No founding year is on the demo until confirmed.
Certifications: GAF (which level, contractor number), Andersen, Pella and CAPS. Proof for each, or we drop them. None is on the demo.
BBB, Wichita Chamber and WABA: are they members, and can we show it?
Kansas roofing licence CT-13-116090: active or expired?
Phone: (316) 295-2159 is on the demo. Does (316) 312-8657 (BuildZoom, Houzz) go to the office?
Email address for the business? None is shown on the site.
Insurance help: one customer (Kamden B.) had Anthony handle the agent and forms. Do you offer that to every roof customer? The demo calls it track record only.
Warranty, financing and free inspections: do you offer them? None is on the demo (free quote only).
Service area: Wichita only, or do you travel to nearby towns? The site says "throughout Kansas" with no towns.
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, no weekend or storm-call hours?
Services to confirm: roof maintenance, gutters and guards, painting, windows, deck staining. Which are the biggest earners, and should any get its own page?
Photos of real jobs, and the owner's okay to use the Google reviews on the site.
